Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron is 0142. Hold Alt, type 0142 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron also has the Unicode codepoint U+017D, so you can type it with Alt+381 on Windows, search for U+017D in macOS's Character Viewer, use Ž in HTML, or \017D in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape Ž or the hex escape Ž.

How to type latin capital letter z with caron on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 4 2 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron character (Ž) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter z with caron on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter z with caron in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\017D"; ()
  • Python: \u017D or chr(0x17D)
  • JavaScript: \u017D or String.fromCodePoint(0x17D)
  • JSON: "\u017D"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron is 0142. Hold Alt, type 0 1 4 2 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Ž without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Ž, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+381 not work?

Alt+381 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter Z With Caron is U+017D. You can use this value in HTML as Ž, in CSS as \017D, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Ž on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+017D, then click it.
